name: bottom-directional-drawer
blurb: Example drawer UI for profile image update, sliding up from bottom.
description: A premade template showing a bottom-sliding drawer with form controls for uploading profile images, using DirectionalDrawer primitive.
use_when: Starting a mobile-friendly form or edit panel that slides up from the bottom.
avoid_when: For reusable drawer functionality — use DirectionalDrawer directly for more flexibility.
a11y: Semantic form elements inside drawer. Relies on DirectionalDrawer's dismissal behavior.
